item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00091","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C01","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are supplements to the same December 16, 1947 proclamation under the same statutory authority. Most distinctively, each responds to a government's accession to the General Agreement by activating previously withheld Schedule XX concessions. They use nearly identical recitals and the same operative machinery: identify the concessions, remove them from the December proclamation's withholding list, and apply the corresponding rates subject to the same agreement provisions and qualifications. C01 and C03 contain closely related machinery, but C12 is the nearest prior iteration in language, structure, and timing.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"said protocol of provisional application
